request: Expand existing timeline events into full readable quest histories, especially World Changing and Interregional events. Nienna’s Hallowing is the explicit example; the owner excludes Alavara from this batch.

scope.reading: Selected original main-quest exchanges, narrator rulings, battle endings and the separate Sanctum return scene. These bounded reviews are not exhaustive reading of every cached message or every campaign event. Existing qualified context and later claims remain identified as such.
scope.excluded: Alavara changes, new timeline milestones, rankings/date changes, raw transcripts, controller identities, intimate material, protected explanations, unreviewed attachments, secret project geography and any new image or NPC.

decisions: Nienna’s existing Regional milestone gains its own eight-chapter story. The source shows the full preparation, fighting, broken wall, Adelia’s fall, protective barrier, departure, farewells, Death’s threat, sustained casting and final life eruption. The owner explicitly identifies her death as saving Hope. The closing outcome is confirmed; the party does not witness further events beyond the Gate.

The July Plains death and Raise Dead remain separate. Nienna’s existing section destinations and all direct quote blocks survive; one formerly broad Hallowing uncertainty is narrowed by the closing narration, and a direct story link is added.

Wrath’s two established World Changing milestones retain their single six-chapter destination. The enlarged story preserves the fort’s wards, Endora discussion, offered self-sacrifices, Elenia’s death and Saray’s finishing blow, then follows the exchange with Death and the companions’ refusal/bargaining through their departure. Claims of cosmic truth and eternal rest remain attributed.

Gartina’s explicit Reincarnate and Elenia’s observed satyr return complete the Wrath aftermath. The retained body, uncertain appearance, shared pleas, casting record and awakening establish a separate restoration; Death’s offers do not cause it. Other lost companions’ returns are not invented.

Aria’s two established World Changing milestones retain the same route and six earlier chapter IDs, with two additional chapters. The disputed mission, one chosen destination, march, two-sided battle, Talan’s killing, Death’s separate massacre, Magnus’s collapse and contested survival, recovered body and successful Plane Shift are all distinguished.

Scribonia’s concealed attack on Aria/Talan is retained beside the narrator’s killing by Talan. Her unused carried relic is retrieved without new mechanics or an invented escape from death. Olokun’s grief, Wren’s refusal, Eugene’s aid and Magnus’s trauma are not resolved into group agreement.

Later Dumuzi testimony that Aria is not dead remains a later claim. No resurrection or missing intervening event is invented. Aria’s established cultural/military role does not become a replacement for Zarathis’s civic institutions.

Only three existing timeline summaries change. Nienna’s people/location become specific to the checked scene and its story link is added. No new milestone, importance change, region/date/Final War adjustment, player/NPC role, map, quotation collection or protected boundary changes.
verification: Static content, source, calendar, portrait, preview and protected-asset checks pass. Focused local timeline/reading checks and the existing hosted story gate cover the expanded stories; publication receipt is recorded in docs/KEY_EVENT_STORIES_2026_10_29.md.
